title: With Trim in hand, the trim bar stays clear of the captions and the notices
goal: A recording no longer opens with Trim in hand (that changed on 2026-09-25), so the bar no longer covers a caption on open. It can still come up over a captioned recording when someone picks Trim, and a caption or a notice under it would be half hidden. Check whether that still happens and fix it if it does.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-23: Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/captions-write-themselves-walk.json, picture 2-the-captions-wrote-themselves-sc.png (queue/audits/2026-09-23-captions-write-themselves-2-the-captions-wrote-themselves.png): the In 0:00 · Out 0:17 · Cancel · Trim capsule covers the middle of the caption line The transport bar and the timeline appear. The capsule comes from document.opensWithTrimInHand (EditorState.openRecordingAsDocument sets .trim). Options: lift the capsule above the caption band, or drop the fast-lane trim once the document has captions.
acceptance: With a captioned recording open and Trim in hand, the bottom caption is fully visible with the trim bar up, or the log says with a picture that it already was
A notice raised on the canvas (Clip added, a refusal) is readable end to end while the trim bar is up and a caption is on screen
A walk with no flags picks Trim on a captioned recording and photographs the three things apart
Works at Next defaults with no switch turned on, and an audit written under queue/audits/ gives the try steps and a real picture

log.note: manager 2026-09-24: folded in a-word-the-canvas-says-is-readable-when-a-trim-i (same capsule, same band at the bottom of the canvas: a notice like Sound added lands under the trim bar). Also seen 2026-09-24 in /tmp/photonz-playtest/an-editing-session-walk/3-second-clip-sc.png: the Clip added notice sits on top of the bottom caption. The fix is one layout for the bottom of the canvas: trim capsule, notice and caption line never overlap.

measure pass 2026-09-24: also seen on a 5 minute .mov opened from disk: the trim bar 'In 0:00 · Out 5:00 · Cancel · Trim' sits over the first caption (docs/design/video-vs-premiere/ five-minutes-at-fit.jpg source 2-captions-sc.png).

digest 2026-09-25: the floating trim bar was in the rough list of three audits in the last day (timeline keys on open, video guides, and the first-frame picture of the cut guide). The real fix, trim-becomes-a-tool-and-the-recording-window-ret, waits on the Command S card, so this task is still the one that helps first.

triage 2026-09-26: bb6c6370 took the Trim-on-open fast lane out (opensWithTrimInHand no longer exists in Sources), so the original picture no longer happens on open. Retitled to the case that may remain, Trim picked by hand over captions, and moved to the back of p2 as an open question.

Reproduced 2026-09-28 with a new walk (Scripts/playtest/trim-bar-clears-captions-and-notices-walk.json, first version): picking Trim right after Add Captions, the offscreen render shows the 'Captions written · 62 words...' notice drawn directly UNDER the trim capsule (both were padded to exactly EditorChromeLayout.aboveToolBar, capsule drawn last), so the notice could not be read at all. The caption itself cleared the capsule by ~20pt at 66% fit, but only by luck of the zoom: the capsule is pinned above the tool bar and the caption is 5% up the picture, so zoomed in (83%) the capsule sits on the caption line. Adversarial pass: the mock (video-cut-wt) has no trim capsule on the canvas at all, so this is app chrome; Premiere keeps trim on the timeline. Fix: one layout for the canvas foot (EditorChromeLayout.canvasFoot, CanvasFootStack view): capsule above the tool bar, notice stacked above the capsule, both lifted just clear of the Captions layer's box when they would cover it; the box, not the cue on screen, so nothing hops during playback.

left rough (in the audit, not filed: the user reacts there, and neither is broken): the bar clears the whole two-line Captions box so it can sit a line higher than needed with one line showing; when the notice has to rise over the caption the order reads notice, caption, trim bar rather than one stack. Walks run green: the new walk plus trim-is-a-tool, captions-write-themselves, undo-while-trimming, trim-with-pieces, the three notice walks, crop-cue, crop-rounds-the-card, an-editing-session (its Clip added pill now clears the caption).

Shipped dd15d5fe: one layout for the foot of the canvas (EditorChromeLayout.canvasFoot + CanvasFootStack). A notice raised with Trim in hand now stacks on top of the trim bar instead of lying hidden under it, and the bar and notice rise just clear of the Captions box when they would cover it. Verified by trim-bar-clears-captions-and-notices-walk at Next defaults (new captionsExpectFootApart check, real window captures of a refusal and of the zoomed-in case), neighbouring walks green, Scripts/test.sh green.
